utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll try to stop by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Bring any tools you have, we'll put them to use.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll see what I can dig up from the shed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I've collected odds and ends over the years. Let me go take a look in the garage right now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so you're actually going to check for spare parts? I still thought this was just a clean-up event.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hold on, I'll be right back with whatever I find—you'll see it's more than just cleaning up!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood. How can I lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sam, it's so great you're interested! The drive is actually now happening Sunday at the community center — we could really use an extra pair of hands sorting donated items.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Rosa! I can do that. I'll bring some tools too, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Now, let's see the list—first up, we've got that fence post of yours, Mina. We'll need some wood and nails from Gus's toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hold on, Eli—are we still talking about the repair drive for the community center's pump, or is this a separate list for people's personal repairs?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, this is the community center list, Hana—I've got it all sorted by priority, and the pump's at the top. Mina's fence post is just a side note for later.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Opal, I'm all set with my toolbox and lemonade—ready to hit the Andersons' place first!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect timing! I've got the Andersons' address marked on my map — they're the blue house with the cracked porch step. Let's head over!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let's go then! I'll grab the lemonade pitcher and meet you at the sidewalk.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So it's like a free fix-it fair? Got it. I might stop by if I can swing it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's right, Bo! The repair drive is on Saturday the 15th. Vik just reminded me about it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday the 15th, got it. I'll add it to my list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late—just catching up. I'm not sure on the specifics, but I can take a look at the pump if you need an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Dane! The repair drive's this Saturday. I've been handing out flyers—want me to save you one?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, save me one—I'll make sure to show up this time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Vik, has anyone actually set a date for this repair drive? I'm still waiting on that fence post.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, we settled on Saturday the 15th! I already told Cleo about it — she's checking her garage for spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I'll mark my calendar. Do I just bring my fence post to the square, or will someone come help?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we actually made a list of what needs repairing? I don't want us running around with tools and no plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good point, Pia! Let's start a list together – I know the community center's water pump is one thing, but I'm sure there are more.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, a list is a must. I can grab a notebook from my place so we can write down each item and what tools we'll need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Tess! I've been hearing bits and pieces about this repair drive—do you know what the main plan is?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, Nell, from what I gather, folks are supposed to bring their broken stuff—furniture, appliances, you name it—and folks with skills will try to fix it up. Jerry's chipping in tools, but parts are still iffy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Parts, huh? That's the tricky bit. I don't have anything broken, but I was wondering if anyone could help with some overgrown bushes out back?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I appreciate you asking, Faye. I'm just trying to help organize things—maybe we could sort through electronics together if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, that sounds good—maybe we can set aside some time after school drop-off tomorrow to sort through what we've got.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works for me. I'll gather up the donated electronics tonight so we can get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, thanks Gus! I'll check my calendar and let you know the day.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I'll have my toolbox ready whenever you need it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Awesome, I'll let you know as soon as I pick a date. Thanks again!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Dane, I'm so glad you're here! I wanted to let you know we've moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday works for me, Rosa. I'll bring my toolbox. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great! Let's plan for 10 AM. I'll have the coffee ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, hey Leo! Yeah, the repair drive—I think Kira said it's a clean-up thing? I'm late for work, so I'll catch you later.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, I'll check with Kira. Let me know if you need a hand this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Leo! I'll definitely let you know—gotta run!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I've got my toolbox ready for the repair drive—let me know what you need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Gus, you're a lifesaver! I've got some overgrown bushes out back that could use a trim—think you could spare some time for that?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Nell! I've got a good pair of trimmers in my toolbox. When's a good time for me to come by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm helping pass out flyers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I sure have. Could you tell me the exact start time and what tools folks should bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure! The repair drive starts at 9 AM at the community center. As for tools, just bring whatever you have—screwdrivers, pliers, and hammers are always helpful.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so is it actually a repair drive? I thought we were just cleaning up this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No, no—it's a proper repair drive, like a community fix-it day where folks bring broken things and we try to mend 'em together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're telling me we're actually fixing stuff, not just picking up litter? I need to be sure before I clear out my Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a repair drive! I think I have some spare parts in my garage. Want me to check what I have that might be useful?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That'd be great, Cleo, just make sure whatever you bring is organized—we don't want a pile of random bits nobody can sort through.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Don't worry, Pia—I'll label everything and sort it by type so folks can actually find what they need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I might have a couple of things. Save me a spot, I suppose.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You know where to find me, Uli. Just give me a shout if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do, Sam. Thanks for looking out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? I'm rounding up the whole neighborhood!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'll be there! I'm mapping out pickup spots—do you have your address handy so I can add you to the route?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing, my address is 42 Elm Street. I can't wait to see everyone pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Jules, when's the repair drive actually starting? I've got a broken fence post that's been waiting weeks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We're kicking it off this Saturday morning at 9, Mina! I'll make sure someone swings by to help with that fence post.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Saturday at 9 works for me. Just make sure whoever comes has the right tools for a fence post.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Tess, just checking in—are we still set for the repair drive this weekend? I've got the lemonade ready to go!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, it's still on! Jerry's bringing tools, but I'm a little nervous about whether they'll have enough parts—people are really hoping for that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Don't worry, I can ask around at the hardware store if we need more parts. Let's make this happen!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Noah, do you know about the repair drive happening soon? I'm thinking of helping out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive! That would be great, thanks Gus—wait, sorry, I mean, thanks Rey. What time is it again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries, Noah. I think it's at 10 AM, but I can double-check. I'm happy to help sort through donated electronics.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So it's a general repair drive, not just the pump. Good to know—I'll bring my old bike then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday the 15th, right? That's what Vik told me... I think I've got it straight this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, Saturday the 15th—I double-checked the flyer. Glad we're all on the same page now.
